note: Every row edits the PRODUCER of a sentence, never the test. `baseline_ref` is the commit before the sweep, so each row also reports what the assertion it replaced did with the same injection: `SURVIVED` is the measurement the sweep exists to take.

mutations.what: drop "or negotiation profile" from the no-chat sentence

mutations.what: the min_n reason stops naming the sample it NEEDS (four sites)

mutations.to: inert.push({ source, reason: `rests on ${n} ${spec.needs}`, as_of: asOf });

mutations.to: return empty('no manager signals for this league yet');
